```yaml
name: DevX Tag Automation

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  tag:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get latest release tag
        id: latest_release
        run: |
          TAG=$(curl -s -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
            https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/releases/latest | jq -r .tag_name)
          echo "latest_release=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Determine next dev tag
        id: dev_tag
        run: |
          RELEASE=${{ steps.latest_release.outputs.latest_release }}
          if [ -z "$RELEASE" ]; then
            echo "no_release=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "release=$RELEASE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          TAGS=$(git tag -l "${RELEASE}.dev*" | sort -V)
          if [ -z "$TAGS" ]; then
            NEXT=1
          else
            LAST=$(echo "$TAGS" | tail -n1)
            NUM=${LAST#${RELEASE}.dev}
            NEXT=$((NUM+1))
          fi
          NEW_TAG="${RELEASE}.dev${NEXT}"
          echo "new_tag=$NEW_TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create and push dev tag
        if: steps.dev_tag.outputs.no_release != 'true'
        run: |
          RELEASE=${{ steps.dev_tag.outputs.release }}
          TAG=${{ steps.dev_tag.outputs.new_tag }}
          # Retry loop to avoid tag collisions
          for i in {1..5}; do
            # Check if tag already exists on remote
            if git ls-remote --tags origin "$TAG" | grep -q "$TAG$"; then
              echo "Tag $TAG already exists on remote, incrementing"
              NUM=${TAG##*.dev}
              NUM=$((NUM+1))
              TAG="${RELEASE}.dev${NUM}"
              continue
            fi
            # Create and push the tag
            git tag "$TAG"
            git push origin "$TAG"
            echo "Created tag $TAG"
            exit 0
          done
          echo "Failed to create a new dev tag after 5 attempts" >&2
          exit 1
```
